## Tipe Perubahan

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Fitur baru
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Dokumentasi

## Daftar Periksa

- [ ] Test sudah ditambahkan/dijalankan (unit/integration)
- [ ] Lint lolos (`composer lint`)
- [ ] Security audit lolos (`composer audit`)
- [ ] Tidak ada hardcoded secret/credential
- [ ] RBAC (permission & module access) sudah diperiksa
- [ ] Response API sesuai standar `ApiResponse`
